use default

let witnesses = [2n, 3n, 5n, 7n, 11n, 13n, 17n, 19n, 23n, 29n, 31n, 37n]

passes(witness: bigint, odd_part: bigint, power: int,
       value: bigint) -> bool is
    let residue mut = bigint.mod_pow(witness, odd_part, value)

    if residue =~ 1n \/ residue =~ value - 1n then return true fi

    for _ in 1..power do
        residue = residue * residue % value

        if residue =~ value - 1n then return true fi
    od

    false
si

is_prime(value: bigint) -> bool is
    if value < 2n then return false fi

    for witness in witnesses do
        if value =~ witness then return true fi
        if value % witness =~ 0n then return false fi
    od

    let odd_part mut = value - 1n
    let power mut = 0

    while odd_part % 2n =~ 0n do
        odd_part = odd_part / 2n
        power = power + 1
    od

    witnesses |> all(witness => passes(witness, odd_part, power, value))
si

pell_recurrence(first: bigint, second: bigint) -> Pipe[bigint] is
    let previous mut = first
    let current mut = second

    do
        yield previous

        let following = current * 2n + previous

        previous = current
        current = following
    od
si

pells() -> Pipe[bigint] => pell_recurrence(0n, 1n)

pell_lucas() -> Pipe[bigint] => pell_recurrence(2n, 2n)

approximations() -> Pipe[(numerator: bigint, denominator: bigint)] =>
    pells()
        |> windows(2)
        |> map(pair =>
            (numerator = pair[0] + pair[1], denominator = pair[1]))

pell_primes() -> Pipe[(index: int, value: bigint)] =>
    pells()
        |> index()
        |> filter(entry => is_prime(entry.value))
        |> map(entry => (index = entry.index, value = entry.value))

newman_shanks_williams() -> Pipe[bigint] =>
    pells() |> chunk(2) |> map(pair => pair[0] + pair[1])

use TRIANGLE = (short: bigint, long: bigint, hypotenuse: bigint)

near_isosceles_triples() -> Pipe[TRIANGLE] is
    let running mut = 0n
    let position mut = 0

    for value in pells() do
        if position % 2 == 1 /\ position > 1 then
            yield (short = running, long = running + 1n, hypotenuse = value)
        fi

        running = running + value
        position = position + 1
    od
si

write_line("the first 10 Pell numbers:")
write_line("  {pells() |> take(10) |> join(" ")}")

write_line()
write_line("the first 10 Pell-Lucas numbers:")
write_line("  {pell_lucas() |> take(10) |> join(" ")}")

write_line()
write_line("the first 10 approximations to the square root of two:")

approximations()
    |> take(10)
    |> each(ratio => (
        let value =
            cast double(ratio.numerator) / cast double(ratio.denominator)

        write_line("  {ratio.numerator}/{ratio.denominator} = {value:F15}")
    ))

write_line()
write_line("the first 10 Pell primes, with their indices:")

pell_primes()
    |> take(10)
    |> each(prime => write_line("  {prime.index,4}: {prime.value}"))

write_line()
write_line("the first 10 Newman-Shanks-Williams numbers:")
write_line("  {newman_shanks_williams() |> take(10) |> join(" ")}")

write_line()
write_line("the first 10 near isosceles right triangles:")

near_isosceles_triples()
    |> take(10)
    |> each(triple =>
        write_line("  {triple.short}, {triple.long}, {triple.hypotenuse}"))
